blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Mary often wears her hair in pigtails.
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: You know how to drive, don't you?

exercises.why: **водит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).

exercises.q: He handled the affairs of the company badly.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Have you ever written a blog?
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Young people have stopped wearing berets.
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: To where leads this difficult path?
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Have you ever worn long underwear?
exercises.why: **носил** — past tense (masculine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: The ancient Greeks often wore tunics.
exercises.why: **носили** — past tense (plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Tom likes to wear tight clothes.
He likes to wear socks with sandals.
You always wear a loud tie.
exercises.why: **носишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Layla loved the way Salima wore hijab.
exercises.why: **носила** — past tense (feminine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
**ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: I don't remember if Don Quixote wore a hat or not.
exercises.why: **носил** — past tense (masculine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.ru: Я уже не помню, ___ Дон Кихот шляпу или нет.

exercises.q: Be careful when carrying sunflower oil.
exercises.why: **несёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: After six games, Sampras had the edge on his opponent.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.ru: По итогу шести геймов Сампрас ___ у соперника.

exercises.q: Tom isn't as good a driver as he used to be.
exercises.why: **водит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).
exercises.ru: Теперь Том ___ машину не так умело, как прежде.
